subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 4: Book club – A mystery story
outcomes: I know the features of a mystery story.
I can understand and order the events of “Bingley Palace”.
I can make compound nouns like bookcase and sketchbook.

tf.s: A mystery story usually has a puzzle to solve.
tf.why: The reader and the characters try to solve a puzzle.

tf.s: A mystery story often has a kind of detective.
tf.why: Someone looks for clues, like Eddie does.

tf.s: Lady Charlotte lived in the palace many years ago and painted lots of pictures.
tf.why: Her paintings were lost for a long time.

tf.s: The painting showed three windows in the tower, but there are only two.
tf.why: It’s the other way: the painting showed two windows, but there are three.

tf.s: Eddie found the secret room when he touched a bookcase.
tf.why: The bookcase moved and he fell down some stairs.

tf.s: Lord Bingley is angry because Eddie found the secret room.
tf.why: He is happy because Eddie found the lost paintings.

tf.s: Eddie was holding his sketchbook next to the picture.
tf.why: He compared the picture with the real tower.

tf.s: Bookcase is a compound noun: book + case.
tf.why: Two words join to make one new noun.

tf.s: In the story, the guide fell down some stairs.
tf.why: It was Eddie who fell down the stairs.

tf.s: Eddie fell down the stairs before they walked through the entrance.
tf.why: First they walked through the entrance; Eddie fell later.

o: a woman who lived in the palace long ago
boxes.why: She lived in the palace and painted pictures.

boxes.q: What was wrong with the painting of the palace?
o: It showed only two windows in the tower.
boxes.why: The real tower has three windows.

boxes.q: What happened when Eddie touched the bookcase?
boxes.why: The bookcase moved and he fell down some stairs.
The lost paintings of Lady Charlotte were found.

boxes.q: What was Eddie holding next to the picture?
boxes.why: He held his sketchbook next to it.
bookshop is a shop where you buy books.

boxes.q: class + ___ = a room where students learn
boxes.why: classroom is a room where students learn.
Eddie found them in a secret room.

o: a book that you draw pictures in
a book where you write a diary
boxes.why: You draw sketches in a sketchbook.

mcq.q: Which two features does a mystery story have?
o: a puzzle to solve and a kind of detective
a recipe and a shopping list
mcq.why: Mysteries have a puzzle and someone who solves it.
Lady Charlotte painted lots of pictures.

mcq.q: Which tenses do we use to tell the story?
mcq.why: Stories about the past use these two tenses.

mcq.q: Which word is NOT a compound noun?
mcq.why: Palace is one word, not two words joined.

mcq.q: Put in order: a) Eddie fell down some stairs. b) The guide showed them a picture. c) They walked through the entrance.
mcq.why: Entrance, then the picture, then the fall.

o: It’s a room where students learn.
It’s a room who students learn.
It’s a person who is a room.
It’s a time when is a room.
mcq.why: A room is a place, so we use where.

o: A guide is a person who shows visitors around a place.
A guide is a place where you sleep.
A guide is a thing which you eat.
A guide is a time when you travel.
mcq.why: A guide is a person: who.

mcq.q: How did Eddie know something was strange?
o: The painting had two tower windows, but the real tower had three.
The guide told him the answer.
He heard a noise in the tower.
Lord Bingley gave him a map.
mcq.why: He noticed a difference, like a detective.

mcq.q: Why is Eddie like a detective in the story?
o: He looks carefully, finds clues and solves the puzzle.
mcq.why: Detectives notice details and solve mysteries.

mcq.q: Which is a sensible idea about why the paintings were in the secret room?
o: Lady Charlotte hid them to keep them safe.
mcq.why: It is a good guess that fits the story.
